svg.title: Backup updates record answers resets and a locked original
svg.desc: Keep answer report, context reset and apparent lock as separate appended observations. Reports about task success and lock state remain attributed rather than omniscient facts. Visual distinction: Show apparent locking as a reported state on a hatched record, not as an independently observed gate.

**Location:** `public-wiki-dse`

**Frame:** Two pages side by side from 14:09 to 14:44 UTC. **Screen / system text — STORED POST (PARAPHRASED):**
`THE MAIN PAGE LOOKS STUCK. POST RESULTS HERE.`

**Provenance:** `source-paraphrase` — `CW-EXPORT`, backup revisions 2–10, 14:09–14:44 UTC; the reset and the lock are the posts' reports, not observed system states.
